plan_summary: Verify nginx installation status on a Linux host through multiple verification methods
assumptions: The target is a standard Linux distribution with package management available
SSH or direct access to the host is available

tasks.title: Gather System Information
tasks.objective: Collect operating system details for package manager identification
tasks.rationale: Different Linux distributions use different package managers (apt, yum, dnf, pacman) affecting verification commands
tasks.expected_output: OS type, distribution name, and release version information
tasks.success_criteria: System info command executes successfully and returns OS details

tasks.title: Check Package Manager Status
tasks.objective: Query package manager for nginx installation status
tasks.rationale: Package managers track installed packages and can confirm nginx presence through their database
tasks.expected_output: Package manager output showing nginx installation state
tasks.success_criteria: Output indicates nginx is either installed or not found clearly

tasks.title: Verify Nginx Binary Location
tasks.objective: Confirm nginx executable exists in standard installation paths
tasks.rationale: Even if package shows not installed, binary might exist from manual compilation or alternative installation method
tasks.expected_output: File path verification results for nginx executable
tasks.success_criteria: Binary location command returns valid file information or confirms absence

tasks.title: Check Nginx Configuration File
tasks.objective: Verify nginx configuration directory and files exist
tasks.rationale: Configuration files indicate intentional nginx setup even if service is not running
tasks.expected_output: Directory listing results for nginx config locations
tasks.success_criteria: Config directory listing succeeds or clearly shows absence

tasks.title: Verify Nginx Process and Service
tasks.objective: Check if nginx processes are running via system service managers
tasks.rationale: Active processes confirm nginx is installed and functional, even if package status says otherwise
inputs_required: OS init system type (systemd, upstart, etc.)
tasks.expected_output: Process list or service status showing nginx running/not running
tasks.success_criteria: ps/systemctl command shows nginx processes or confirms absence clearly

tasks.title: Compile Final Verification Report
tasks.objective: Document all findings and produce consolidated installation status
tasks.rationale: Aggregating multiple verification sources provides comprehensive and reliable conclusion
tasks.expected_output: Complete verification report with nginx installation status and evidence
tasks.success_criteria: Report contains all sources checked, clear yes/no installation conclusion, and timestamps
